title: 6 Things a Godly Man Forgives Fast in Others and Refuses to Excuse in Himself
caption:
Grace for everyone else. An audit for himself.

Matthew 7:3 asks why you notice the speck in your brother's eye and miss the log in your own. Most guys run that verse backwards, quick to excuse others, slow to forgive themselves.

The same grace you hand your friend on his worst week is the grace God's already handing you.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #grace #selfcompassion
theme: He's hard on himself, gentle with others.
